card.name: Partway through Latin scientific names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long Latin or Greek-based biological words, such as pseud- before opods or otuberculosis, or vit-ell-inus in species names. It also fires on a few place and science terms in citations.

modes.label: pseudo- words
modes.description: The start piece pseud before opods, opodia or otuberculosis.

modes.label: Species and microbe names
modes.description: Middle pieces of genus or species names and microscopic organism names.

modes.label: Place and geology terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of place or geology words in reference lists.

card.plain: It fires inside long Latin-style biology names before the rest of the word is finished.
